newsitem.title: UK: UK consumer leading indicator hits record high-NTC.
newsitem.headline: UK consumer leading indicator hits record high-NTC.

text.p: Britain's consumer industries' leading indicator rose for the sixth consecutive month in June, to a record high of 108.9, NTC said on Thursday.

The British economic research body said last month's increase could be attributed to a rise in the number of job vacancies, further strong growth in retail sales, high consumer confidence and continued buoyancy of television advertising expenditure.
The indicator tends to move ahead of Britain's economic cycle by 11 months, NTC said. In general, the higher the indicator, the faster the rate of economic growth signalled.
